propositions: CLI reference syntax sections must be generated from runtime parser artifacts and committed help bytes, validated by --check mode achieving byte-idempotence across Python versions
Curated command census, source regex parsing, and manual INTERCEPT_COMMANDS definitions must be eliminated in favor of registry enumeration as the single source of truth
Test suites for help/argparse/exit-code coverage must derive route/command enumerations from canonical registry policy sets rather than reconstructing hand-maintained unions
A clean no-extras wheel must render all approved help forms with exact committed bytes and demonstrate no side effects from config/store/operation/handler/heavy imports
Editorial prose, examples, and rationale must be structurally separated from generated syntax and validated via lint rules that reject editorial syntax-table authorities and unknown command spellings
